bai: Bai 24 - Record Macro (ghi macro tu dong)
cong_thuc: Developer tab: Right-click Ribbon > Customize the Ribbon > tick Developer (neu chua co).
Developer > Record Macro: mo hop thoại dat ten (viet lien, khong dau), shortcut key (nen bo trong tranh trung), Store in: This Workbook, Description tuy y.
Stop Recording (nut vuong o Developer hoac thanh trang thai): dung ghi sau khi lam xong thao tac.
Sub GhiMacro() ... End Sub: khung chuong trinh macro sinh ra trong Module (Alt+F11 xem).
' (dau nhay don): bien dong thanh ghi chu; dung de vo hieu hoa lenh nhu Range("D9").Select.
Selection.* : lenh ap len vung dang chon; xoa dong Range("D9").Select de macro chay cho moi o.
Developer > Insert > Button (Form Control): ve nut, gán macro trong Assign Macro; Right-click > Edit Text doi ten nut.
Shape (Insert > Shapes) + Right-click > Assign Macro: dung hinh lam nut bam dep hon.
Sheets("Du lieu 1").Select: lenh nhay toi sheet chi dinh (record duoc khi click qua sheet).
Copy nut: Ctrl+keo nut hoac Copy/Paste; nut copy giu nguyen macro duoc gan.
Ctrl + mui ten xuong: nhay toi dong cuoi vung (dung trong macro nhap lieu de tim dong trong).
Use Relative References (Developer): BAT truoc khi ghi doan dich chuyen tuong doi (nhap lieu tu dong).
Paste Special > Transpose: xoay du lieu cot thanh hang khi nhap lieu (record thao tac nay).
Ctrl+T + Advanced Filter: chuan hoa vung du lieu truoc khi record macro tim kiem.
Luu file .xlsm (Excel Macro-Enabled Workbook) de giu lai macro; .xlsx se mat macro.
Alt+F11 + View > Immediate (Ctrl+G): mo VBE xem Module/Sub sinh ra khi Record; mo song song de hoc lenh (VLOOKUP, Filter, Format).
Home > Clear > Clear Formats: xoa dinh dang vung test truoc khi bam nut chay macro de thay ro ket qua.
thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: bat the Developer (Customize Ribbon); chuan bi cac sheet: Main (muc luc), Du lieu 1/2/3, Input, Data, Tim kiem.
Buoc 2 (muc luc): ve Shape 'Du lieu thang 1', Record Macro ten Thang1 (This Workbook) > click sang sheet Du lieu 1 > Stop; Assign macro vao shape. Lap lai Thang2/Thang3.
Buoc 3 (nut ve): record macro QuayLaiMain (click ve sheet Main) > tao nut 'Quay lai muc luc' tren moi sheet du lieu, gan macro; copy nut cho nhanh.

Buoc 4 (nhap lieu): tao nut 'Cap nhat'; Record: copy vung nhap Input > sang Data, click o dau (B3), Ctrl+mui ten xuong, BAT Use Relative References, mui ten xuong 1 o, Paste Special Transpose, TAT nut tuong doi, ve Input xoa trang, Stop; gan macro vao nut.
Buoc 5 (tim kiem): chuan hoa vung bang Ctrl+T; record cac buoc Advanced Filter theo dieu kien (Ho Nguyen, Gioi tinh Nu...) roi gan vao nut Tim kiem / Tim moi.
Buoc 6: mo VBE (Alt+F11), xoa dong Range co dinh thua, them ghi chu; test moi nut 2-3 lan, luu file .xlsm.

cau_hoi.cau: Record Macro la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Cong cu ghi lai thao tac de tu sinh code VBA
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Khong biet lenh van record roi xem code de hoc.

cau_hoi.cau: Record Macro nam o the nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Neu chua co thi bat trong Customize Ribbon.

cau_hoi.cau: Bat the Developer bang cach nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Right-click Ribbon > Customize the Ribbon > tick Developer
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tick Developer ben phai roi OK.

cau_hoi.cau: Khi dat ten macro can chu y gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ten co dau cach se bao loi khi chay.

cau_hoi.cau: O Shortcut key khi record nen?
cau_hoi.A: Bo trong neu khong can thiet
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Trung phim tat san se xung dot, chay sai.

cau_hoi.cau: Store macro in: This Workbook nghia la?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: This Workbook gioi han pham vi file hien tai.

cau_hoi.cau: Personal Macro Workbook dung khi nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Muon macro dung chung moi file
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Luu ca nhan de mo file nao cung chay duoc.

cau_hoi.cau: Nut dung ghi macro la nut nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nam o Developer hoac thanh trang thai duoi man hinh.

cau_hoi.cau: Code macro duoc luu o dau?
cau_hoi.A: Module trong cua so Visual Basic (VBA)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Moi lan record sinh 1 Module chua Sub...End Sub.

cau_hoi.cau: Mo cua so Visual Basic bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: VBE hien code song song de theo doi khi record.

cau_hoi.cau: Khung mot macro bat dau va ket thuc bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Moi macro la mot Sub co ten viet lien.

cau_hoi.cau: Dong chu xanh trong code la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dau nhay don bien dong thanh chu thich.

cau_hoi.cau: Moi thao tac dinh dang (bold, mau, ke khung) khi record se?
cau_hoi.A: Sinh 1 doan code tuong ung
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bold/mau/ke khung/gach chan deu co lenh rieng.

cau_hoi.cau: Dong Range("D9").Select dau macro co y nghia?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: Macro chi chay dung o D9
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Record nho ca o bat dau, muon tong quat phai xoa.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon macro dinh dang ap cho moi o duoc chon thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Xoa (hoac ' vo hieu) dong Range co dinh, giu Selection
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Selection la vung dang chon linh hoat.

cau_hoi.cau: Tao nut bam chay macro bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ve nut roi chon macro trong Assign Macro.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi chu tren nut bang?
cau_hoi.A: Right-click > Edit Text
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Edit Text cho phep sua nhan nut.

cau_hoi.cau: Dung hinh Shape lam nut thi gan macro bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Shape dep hon nut mac dinh, cung gan macro.

cau_hoi.cau: Hai nut (Button va Shape) cung gan 1 macro thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nut chi la vo, code chay la nhu nhau.

cau_hoi.cau: Truoc khi test nut dinh dang nen?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Clear de thay ro macro to mau/ke khung lai.

cau_hoi.cau: De lam muc luc nhay sheet can record gi?
cau_hoi.A: Click sang sheet dich (sinh Sheets(...).Select)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Record nho thao tac chuyen sheet.

cau_hoi.cau: Lenh Sheets("Du lieu 1").Select co tac dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Day la lenh dieu huong chinh cua muc luc.

cau_hoi.cau: Nut 'Quay lai muc luc' tren moi sheet du lieu gan macro nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Record 1 macro ve Main roi gan cho moi nut.

cau_hoi.cau: Copy nhanh 1 nut sang sheet khac bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nut copy giu nguyen macro da gan.

cau_hoi.cau: Tieu de 'Bang muc luc' can giua nhieu cot bang?
cau_hoi.A: Format Cells > Alignment > Center Across Selection
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Can giua ma khong merge, tien record.

cau_hoi.cau: Trong macro nhap lieu, kho khan nhat la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: Ghi dung dong trong tiep theo, khong de len dong cu
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Phai ket hop Ctrl+mui ten + Relative moi dung.

cau_hoi.cau: Ctrl + mui ten xuong trong sheet Data de?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Nhay toi dong cuoi co du lieu
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tu dong dau nhay xuong day de them tiep.

cau_hoi.cau: Use Relative References BAT khi nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Truoc doan nhay xuong 1 o de ghi tuong doi
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bat thi buoc mui ten moi dich chuyen theo vi tri.

cau_hoi.cau: Dau hieu nut Relative dang BAT la?
cau_hoi.A: Nut hoi chim/mờ khac thuong
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bieu tuong thay doi trang thai khi kich hoat.

cau_hoi.cau: Sau khi paste xong phai lam gi voi nut Relative?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chi bat cho 1 buoc nhay, xong tat keo anh huong lan sau.

cau_hoi.cau: Paste Special > Transpose de?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Xoay cot thanh hang (du lieu nhap doc -> ghi ngang)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Input nhap doc, Data luu ngang nen phai xoay.

cau_hoi.cau: Sau khi record nhap lieu xong phai?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Ve Input xoa trang o nhap roi Stop
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Xoa de lan sau nhap moi sach se.

cau_hoi.cau: Test macro nhap lieu bang cach?
cau_hoi.A: Nhap NV moi > bam Cap nhat > sang Data kiem tra
cau_hoi.giai_thich: VD NV so 4 'Ga Excel' phai them dung dong.

cau_hoi.cau: Macro tim kiem trong bai dung cong cu nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Record cac buoc loc nang cao theo Ho/Ten/Gioi tinh.

cau_hoi.cau: Truoc khi record macro loc can?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Table giu vung loc on dinh khi them dong.

cau_hoi.cau: Nut 'Tim moi' (xoa dieu kien) de?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Xoa loc cu truoc khi tim tieu chi moi
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Xoa ket qua cu roi nhap Ho/Gioi tinh moi.

cau_hoi.cau: Vi du tim Ho Nguyen + Nu cho may ket qua?
cau_hoi.A: 1 ban (vua Ho Nguyen vua Nu)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Loc ket hop 2 dieu kien chi con 1 ban.

cau_hoi.cau: Loi ich record doi voi nguoi khong biet lap trinh?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: Van tao duoc cong cu tu dong nhu muc luc/nhap lieu
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bam record, Excel viet code ho.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon xem lenh VLOOKUP duoc record ra sao thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.C: Record thao tac go VLOOKUP roi mo VBE xem
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Cach hoc lenh moi: record roi doc code.

cau_hoi.cau: File co macro khi luu phai chon dinh dang gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: .xlsx se lam mat macro khi mo lai.
